macro_context.market_sentiment: Risk-on as of May 6: S&P 500 +0.72%, Nasdaq +0.73%, Russell 2000 +1.75% on hopes for a U.S.-Iran ceasefire deal reducing geopolitical premium in oil prices. Broad tech earnings beat season (AMD, Apple) is lifting sentiment further.
macro_context.fed_outlook: Fed held rates steady at 3.50%–3.75% at its April 29 meeting (Powell's final meeting as Chair), with an 8-4 vote split and no rate cuts expected for 2026; markets pricing in one 25 bps cut in December 2027. Inflation remains elevated partly due to elevated energy prices.
macro_context.geopolitical: U.S.-Iran conflict has been the dominant risk this week — UAE intercepted missiles May 4, oil briefly spiked to ~$110/bbl, but a ceasefire MOU is reportedly close, bringing WTI back toward $104. Additional risks include U.S.-China trade tensions, tariffs, and NATO posture on Greenland.
key_events: U.S.-Iran ceasefire negotiations — outcome could sharply move oil prices and market risk appetite
Fed leadership transition — Powell stepping down after April 29 meeting; new Chair selection pending
Global memory supply crunch impacting tech sector costs — Samsung, SK Hynix adding capacity
Ongoing Q1 2026 earnings season with tech broadly beating estimates

ticker_news.headline: Apple Q2 FY2026 earnings beat: Revenue +17% YoY to $111.2B, iPhone sales +22% to $57B, EPS $2.01 vs. $1.94 estimate
Apple shares hit new all-time closing high of $284.22 on May 5, 2026
Apple's board authorizes $100 billion share buyback for fiscal 2026; new quarterly dividend of $0.27 payable May 14
CEO Tim Cook warns of extended memory cost headwind: 'We'll look at a range of options' — supply constraints cited as growing risk
Apple exploring Intel chip production for U.S. devices — Intel shares up 6.4% pre-market on the report

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: BNP Paribas raised price target to $300 on April 17, 2026. Wedbush (Dan Ives) maintains bull target of $350. Raymond James downgraded to Market Perform at start of 2026. Overall 78% Buy consensus among ~77 Wall Street analysts; mean target ~$301-$304, range $215-$350.

web_context.competitor_activity: Samsung remains Apple's fiercest smartphone rival but Apple overtook Samsung in global shipments for first time in 14 years (2025), driven by iPhone 17 demand. Alphabet (Google) surpassed Apple in market cap (Apple now #3 globally behind NVIDIA and Alphabet). Microsoft dominates in AI cloud and productivity — an area where Apple is seen as lagging. Memory suppliers Samsung and SK Hynix are under pressure to expand capacity amid AI-driven shortages, which raises costs for Apple's entire product line.
web_context.earnings_info: Next earnings: July 30, 2026 (after market close, confirmed). Most recent quarter: Q2 FY2026 reported April 30, 2026 — EPS $2.01 (beat estimate of $1.94), revenue $111.2B (+17% YoY). Q3 FY2026 consensus EPS estimate not yet widely published.
